description: Dex Agents CLI configuration behavior every CLI runtime must match: YAML parsing, schema validation, file defaults, session override narrowing, operation names, and the shell allow list. Hand-written; see README.md and agents/cli/README.md.

error_codes.yaml: The file is not one YAML 1.2 document with unique keys. path is always "".
error_codes.schema: The value fails the schema. A case passes when validation fails and one of the validator's errors, nested anyOf errors included, has instance location path and keyword keyword.
error_codes.duplicate_tool: One entry names the same operation twice, in two spellings. path is the entry.
error_codes.duplicate_connection: Two entries cover the same connection. path is the later entry.
error_codes.model_required: Neither the file nor the harness command gives a model.
error_codes.widens_connectors: A session entry is not inside any entry of the file. path is the entry.
error_codes.widens_local_tools: A session switches on what the file switches off, or allows a command the file does not.

check_order: Report the first failure in this order: yaml; schema; then connector entries in list order, each checked for duplicate_tool, duplicate_connection against earlier entries, and (sessions only) widens_connectors; then model_required; then local_tools in the order files, shell.enabled, shell.allow by index, web_fetch, browser.
